grid.layout_notes: Official layout 3-4-4-4-2. Fifth reel: all symbols count double when fully landed; no lows; Gunslinger + Hog Me Tight in main/Redemption; Salvation holds only Hog Me Tight on reel 5.

win_system.notes: 384 ways from 3x4x4x4x2 layout (page). Reel 5 symbols count as double when fully landed.

other.name: xNudge
other.how_it_works: Stacked Wild on middle three reels always nudges fully visible; each nudge +1 win mult. Base: multiple Nudge Wilds add; bonus modes: multiply each other.

other.name: xSplit / Hog Me Tight
other.how_it_works: 2 Diamondback activates Reel Split Wild on middle three (halves symbols, doubles count). Hog Me Tight on last reel (2 high, Wild) splits middle rows leftward; split Nudge Wild doubles its multiplier.

other.name: Quick Draw
other.how_it_works: 1 revolver cylinder on reel 1 randomly shoots 3-6 times (by bullets); each shot doubles hit symbol multiplier.

other.name: Shootout
other.how_it_works: 2 Sheriff Badges on reels 2 and 4: all low win symbols on center 3 reels act as Wilds.

other.name: xRip
other.how_it_works: If total paytable payout is below base bet (main or bonus), no payout.

wilds.name: Nudge Wild (xNudge)
wilds.behavior: Middle three reels; nudges fully visible; +1 mult per nudge. Base adds; bonus multiplies. Split doubles Nudge mult.

wilds.name: Reel Split Wild
wilds.behavior: From 2 Diamondback on middle three; splits reel symbols in half.

wilds.name: Hog Me Tight Scatter
wilds.behavior: Last reel only; 2 high; Wild; splits middle rows left; with 3 Diamondback upgrades to Salvation.

scatters.name: Diamondback Scatter
scatters.behavior: Middle three reels in main. 3 awards 5 Redemption Spins; 3 + Hog Me Tight awards 6 Salvation. Only 2 converts to Reel Split Wilds.

scatters.name: Hog Me Tight Scatter
scatters.behavior: Last reel; upgrades Redemption to Salvation (+1 spin to 6) or splits left if alone.

scatters.name: RIP Scatter
scatters.behavior: 3 RIP during bonus retrigger: +5 Redemption or +6 Salvation.

scatters.name: Sheriff Badge
scatters.behavior: 2 on reels 2 and 4 trigger Shootout (lows wild on center 3).

scatters.name: Revolver cylinder
scatters.behavior: 1 on reel 1 triggers Quick Draw (3-6 shots doubling hit mult).

multipliers.name: Nudge / Quick Draw multipliers
multipliers.behavior: Nudge Wild x1-x4 contribute to persistent bonus win mult; Quick Draw doubles hit symbol mult per shot.

base_game_loop.summary: Spin on 3-4-4-4-2 ways (384). Optional xBet +150% (Scatter on reel 2, more than double Redemption/Salvation chance) or Double xBet +1400% (Scatter on 2+3, about 10x trigger). xNudge on middle reels; 2 Diamondback to xSplit; Quick Draw / Shootout modifiers; xRip voids sub-stake pays. 3 Diamondback awards 5 Redemption; +Hog Me Tight awards 6 Salvation. Buys 80-1,500x.

phases.state_changes: Stake x2.5 or x15 if ante on

phases.name: Evaluate + xRip
phases.what_happens: Pay ways; if total below base bet, xRip zeros payout.

phases.name: Bonus check
phases.what_happens: 3 Diamondback awards 5 Redemption; +Hog Me Tight awards 6 Salvation.

modes.name: Redemption Spins
modes.retrigger: 3 RIP Scatter awards +5 spins. Landing Hog Me Tight on last reel upgrades to Salvation (+1 spin).
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Win mult from Nudge Wilds (x1-x4) remains; further Nudge Wilds multiply the collected mult.
modes.progressive_state: Persistent win multiplier across Redemption spins.

phases.name: Enter Redemption
phases.what_happens: Award 5 spins; Nudge Wild mults stick and multiply each other.

phases.name: Upgrade / retrigger
phases.what_happens: Hog Me Tight upgrades to Salvation (+1); 3 RIP awards +5 spins.

modes.effects: 5 FS; sticky multiplying Nudge win mult; upgradeable to Salvation; RIP retrigger +5.

modes.name: Salvation Spins
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Reel 5 always holds Hog Me Tight (Wild + splits middle row every spin). Nudge Wild mults stick and multiply.
modes.progressive_state: Persistent win multiplier; perpetual Hog Me Tight on reel 5.

phases.name: Enter Salvation
phases.what_happens: 6 spins; reel 5 locked Hog Me Tight Wild+split; Nudge mults persist/multiply.

modes.effects: 6 FS; locked Hog Me Tight on reel 5; sticky multiplying Nudge mult; RIP +6.
